# Old Testament Violence Claim Audit

**Lesson:** T4-L10 - Old Testament Violence

## Purpose

Support the primary activity for Old Testament Violence.

## Instructions

1. Read the principal passage.
2. Record direct observations.
3. Separate interpretation from application.
4. Name one faithful response.

## Text

Deuteronomy 7:1-11; Joshua 6; Jonah 4

## Big idea

Violence texts require attention to genre, ancient context, judgment claims, canonical development, and moral objections.

## Guardrails

Present the strongest moral objections to conquest texts rather than caricaturing them. | Separate ancient judgment claims from modern war authorization; these texts do not give contemporary Christians a standing mandate for conquest.
